user.title: Connect your lamp
user.description: Local connection to philips.light.sread2. Enter its home-network IP address and 32-character miIO token. No Xiaomi account is needed.

reconfigure.title: Change connection settings
reconfigure.description: Enter the new IP address. Leave the token blank to keep the saved token. The address must belong to the same lamp.

error.invalid_token: Enter exactly 32 hexadecimal characters, without the b prefix or quotes.
error.placeholder_token: That is a handshake marker, not a token. A lamp answers all f once it is provisioned and refuses to hand its token over, and all zeros while it is in setup mode. The real token is needed.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without https:// or a path.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect: {reason} Check Settings > System > Logs for philips_eyecare, and download diagnostics for the full probe.
error.unsupported_model: Only philips.light.sread2 is supported in this version; the lamp {reason}.
error.invalid_response: The lamp returned incomplete or unexpected properties: {reason}. Diagnostics contain every property the lamp answered.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different lamp. Add it as a new integration.
